topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I can't believe it. We just moved in, and now there's a whole other space we didn't know about? The real estate agent swore this was a standard three-bedroom. minced words, I'm questioning everything now. What else are they hiding? This secret room—it's not just a surprise, it's a betrayal of trust. We should have been told. Now, I'm going through every inch of this place, checking for more lies, more secrets. What if it's dangerous in there, or illegal? I don't even want to think about it. We need to get to the bottom of this, and fast.
